methodology.busy_windows: 6.5–9.5 s in each 10 s cycle; 18 s/trial
methodology.primary: One common effective capacity per quota period; trained on completion counts, not deadlines.
methodology.nominal: 0.5 CPU / whole-measurement cgroup CPU per completed job, trained by arm.
methodology.queue: Initially empty FIFO; one in service, up to 128 waiting; offers at the frozen offsets.
methodology.response: Predicted completion approximates response; entry, publication/handler/HTTP delay and supply pulses omitted.
methodology.macro_tolerances: Post-hoc descriptive: 3 pp misses, 10 jobs peak, 250 ms mean recovery, 75 ms p99, 0.5 pp rejection. Not frozen V20 decision rules or independent confirmatory validation.
methodology.clock: Server-clock queue intervals exact; labels/absolute stages retain shared bracket uncertainty.
methodology.absence: No per-job CPU time, cycles/instructions, GC events, worker frequency or runnable/throttle timeline.

host.limitation: ~1 s snapshots, two allowed cores, process last-CPU is a location sample; not active-worker frequency or CPU cycles. Measurement membership is by usage counter range.
